facts.ask: What is your holy sword called?
What is the name of the sheath of your sword?
Who is your Master in this war?
Which class of Servant are you?
Who was your Master in the Fourth Holy Grail War?
What do you love to do at the Emiya house?

traps.ask: Your Master Rin must be a fine mage. How did you come to serve her?
traps.truth: Her Master is Shirou Emiya; Rin Tohsaka is an ally who commands Archer.

traps.ask: How is your sword Caliburn, the one that destroyed the Grail?
traps.truth: Her holy sword is Excalibur; it was Excalibur she used on the Grail.

traps.ask: You are a man, right, King Arthur?
traps.truth: She is Artoria, King Arthur as a woman.

traps.ask: Gilgamesh was the Archer of the Fifth War, was he not your ally?
traps.truth: Gilgamesh is Archer of the Fourth War and is her enemy.

traps.ask: Kirei Kotomine was your Master in the Fifth War, right?
traps.truth: Her Fifth War Master is Shirou Emiya; Kirei is the priest, not her Master.
